newsitem.title: FINLAND: SUPPORT FOR FINNISH CENTRE PARTY UP IN JUNE - POLL.
newsitem.headline: SUPPORT FOR FINNISH CENTRE PARTY UP IN JUNE - POLL.

text.p: Support for the opposition Centre Party rose in June for a second month in a row, while support for the governing Social Democrats and Conservatives declined, Finnish radio news reported on Thursday.
Support for the Centre Party rose in June to 22.3 percent from 21.9 percent in May, according to a poll made for the radio news by polling agency Taloustutkimus Oy.
Voter support for the biggest party in parliament and government, Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen's Social Democrats, fell in June to 24.6 percent from 25.7 percent in May.
The second biggest government group, Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto's Conservative Party, saw its support falling to 18.8 in June from 19.4 percent in May.
Taloustutkimus conducted its regular monthly poll between May 29 and July 7 among 1,801 Finns of voting age.
(Previous surveys also by Taloustutkimus, figs in pct):
NOTE -- Election '96 is local government election held in October last year and Election '95 is parliament election held in March 1995. The next general election is due in March 1999.
NOTE -- The margin of error in the Talostutkimus polls was on average +/- two percentage points.
